incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout's only ERROR spans in the 5-minute window are its client spans oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart: increase 2.5 spans/5m, while oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge all show ERROR increase 0 over the same window.

Checkout client spans for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart carry error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=9 with the description "Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis ... cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() ... EmptyCartAsync"; observed durations 227,565,757 us (trace f7180b1e0319ed9586b0e088aace2a98), 210,694,001 us (trace f41794c984d4a9fe117a3060d49cd222) and 44,129,736 us (trace bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f).

Checkout's PlaceOrder spans in those same traces completed with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 but took 227,627,188 us, 210,739,766 us and 44,165,058 us, i.e. the slow PlaceOrder coincides with the failing EmptyCart call rather than with a PlaceOrder-level error status.

Cart's own server span POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (span 074b17d8150a6059, trace bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f) recorded ERROR with otel.status_code=ERROR and exception logs of type Grpc.Core.RpcException with message "Can't access cart storage ... Wasn't able to connect to redis ... ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() ... EmptyCartAsync", lasting 44,127,284 us; its parent is checkout's oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart span eb32d36cd873718e.

Cart's ERROR spans in the window are specifically span_name POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (increase 2.5/5m); checkout's error series for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart matches that count exactly (2.5/5m), consistent with one failing cart call per failed checkout client span.

Comparable-baseline latency (same length windows, 13:35:27Z–13:40:27Z vs 14:35:27Z–14:40:27Z): cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart average span duration 3.923 ms -> 90,368.011 ms; checkout oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 4.341 ms -> 90,568.881 ms; checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 47.249 ms -> 90,628.793 ms.

Onset in 5-minute buckets: cart EmptyCart average duration was 4.1–14.1 ms from 12:45:27Z through the bucket ending 14:20:27Z, then 48,361.605 ms (bucket ending 14:25:27Z), 18.213 ms (14:30:27Z), 41,075.652 ms (14:35:27Z) and 90,368.011 ms (14:40:27Z); matching error increases were 0 through the bucket ending 14:20:27Z, then 5, 0, 2.506 and 2.5 spans per 5m.

Dependency error check for the same 5-minute window: payment ERROR increase 0 (STATUS_CODE_UNSET 10 spans), and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for product-catalog, currency, shipping or email, while cart and checkout each returned 2.5.

Dependency latency vs the 13:35:27Z–13:40:27Z baseline (average span duration, current -> baseline): payment 2.676 ms -> 1.973 ms, product-catalog 0.310 ms -> 0.277 ms, currency 0.788 ms -> 0.882 ms, email 4.048 ms -> 4.101 ms, shipping 7.056 ms -> 3.351 ms; only cart moved to second-scale (1,897.619 ms -> 1.080 ms), driven by EmptyCart.

Sampled spans for the healthy-checked dependencies show success statuses: payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 1,885–5,105 us and charge 843–3,071 us with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (traces 4960257a85b4e3f83a8052ba77274ca8, 57f3244779cfbff254c23a14958d89df, bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f); product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 61–765 us rpc.grpc.status_code=0; currency Currency/Convert 364–1,139 us with otel.status_code OK; shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 2,651–4,917 us and ShipOrder 17–247 us rpc.grpc.status_code=0; email POST /send_order_confirmation 6,777 us HTTP 200.

Cart's non-EmptyCart redis-backed operations stayed fast in the same traces, including trace bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f at 14:39:16Z where POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart took 313 us with HGET 229 us, and other cart HGET spans were 157–735 us, AddItem 1,294–1,732 us, HMSET 193–363 us, EXPIRE 123–237 us; app_cart_get_cart_latency average was 981,165.9 vs 822,011.9 in the baseline window.

Redis instances' own metrics in 14:10:27Z–14:40:27Z show redis_clients_connected constant at 3, increase(redis_connections_rejected_total[300s]) = 0, redis_clients_blocked = 0, redis_commands_per_second 0–2, and redis_uptime_seconds_total rising monotonically 145,746 -> 147,546 (no restart).

The traced service identities returned for traces_span_metrics_calls_total are ad, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator, payment, product-catalog, quote, recommendation and shipping; no 'redis' service_name appears, so redis is not a traced service identity in this data.

Client-visible errors appear on the same sampled requests: in trace bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f the load-generator POST span returned http.status_code=504 / otel.status_code=ERROR after 15,008,142 us while frontend POST /api/checkout returned 200 after 44,174,875 us; frontend-proxy ingress 504 spans and load-generator POST 504 spans also appear in traces 4960257a85b4e3f83a8052ba77274ca8 and 57f3244779cfbff254c23a14958d89df.

Checkout's current error and latency elevation is secondary to cart: checkout's own failing spans are exactly its EmptyCart client calls, cart's own server span for the same operation is the one that errors with the redis/valkey connection message, and PlaceOrder duration follows the EmptyCart duration in the same traces.

The 44–227 s durations on EmptyCart are consistent with connection-attempt timeouts inside cart's redis client (EnsureRedisConnected) rather than a fast injected rejection; redis process metrics are healthy while cart's GetCart/HGET path in the same traces stays sub-millisecond, so the fault appears confined to the EmptyCart connection path (network/pool/resolution) rather than to redis overall. This is a hypothesis: no redis-side or network evidence shows the mechanism.

A feature-flag/fault-injection path cannot be excluded: cart's failing POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart span is immediately preceded by a flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean span (3,163 us, rpc.grpc.status_code=0) in trace bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f, and cart's healthy GetCart/AddItem calls also evaluate flagd, so the available evidence does not identify which flag was resolved or whether it enabled a failure.

The load-generator/frontend-proxy 504s are most plausibly client timeouts on the slow checkout request: in trace bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f the 504 appears at ~15.0 s while the same trace's checkout PlaceOrder and frontend /api/checkout continue to ~44.2 s, and the durations 210–227 s of other PlaceOrder spans exceed that timeout by far. Downstream customer impact beyond these sampled requests is not verified.

Payment is not the failing dependency in the current window: payment ERROR increase is 0 with 10 UNSET spans, its average span duration is 2.676 ms vs 1.973 ms baseline, and sampled payment Charge spans return rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in 843–5,105 us.

A redis process outage is not supported as the visible cause: redis_uptime_seconds_total rises monotonically (no restart), connections_rejected increase is 0, clients_blocked is 0 and clients_connected stays at 3 throughout 14:10:27Z–14:40:27Z, even though cart's EmptyCart reports an inability to connect to redis.

Checkout PlaceOrder ERROR spans are not elevated in the current window: the checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error series is 0 in every 5-minute bucket from 13:30:27Z through 14:40:27Z (nonzero values 6.25/3.75/1.25/2.495/1.252 appear only in earlier buckets ending 12:45:27Z–13:25:27Z, an earlier episode not tied to this cart/redis evidence).

Cart itself is not uniformly broken: its GetCart, AddItem, HGET, HMSET and EXPIRE spans in the sampled traces carry no error status and stay at 0.1–1.7 ms, and app_cart_get_cart_latency moved only from 822,011.9 to 981,165.9, so the failure is specific to the EmptyCart/redis-connect path.

gaps: kubernetes_state is not integrated, so pod/container state for cart and its redis/valkey server (restarts, readiness, resource pressure, network policy) could not be checked; pod_logs and change_history are likewise unavailable, so the redis-connection failure's mechanism and any configuration change are unverified.

Only one redis series was returned and it carries no instance/namespace label; redis_memory_used_bytes and keyspace series were not returned by the queries issued, so whether that redis series is the store cart uses, and its memory/maxclients state, remain unknown.

Trace evidence is sampled and incomplete: checkout's search returned 366 spans of which only the first 40 rows were read, cart searches returned 3–5 traces with incomplete_reason stating more may exist, so per-request failure rates and the full call chains are unknown; an omitted span stays unknown.
The earlier checkout PlaceOrder/PaymentService error episode in buckets ending 12:45:27Z–13:25:27Z was not investigated and is not explained by the current cart/redis evidence.
Whether the 504s at load-generator/frontend-proxy affected real customer traffic, and how many requests timed out, is not measured; only sampled traces were observed.

Check flagd flag definitions and any flag change near 14:20Z to rule in or out fault injection on the cart EmptyCart path.
Confirm that the queried redis metrics belong to the redis/valkey instance backing cart by checking scrape target labels, and review redis memory and maxclients there.
Quantify the error/timeout rate for checkout requests from load-generator and frontend-proxy over 14:20Z–14:41Z rather than relying on a sampled trace view.
report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T14:35:27Z–14:40:27Z) checkout shows elevated errors and latency, and the evidence localizes both to its cart dependency's redis-backed EmptyCart path. Checkout's only ERROR spans are its client spans for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (increase 2.5 spans/5m; PlaceOrder, prepareOrderItems and PaymentService/Charge error increases are 0), carrying rpc.grpc.status_code=9 and the cart error text "Can't access cart storage ... Wasn't able to connect to redis" (traces f7180b1e0319ed9586b0e088aace2a98, f41794c984d4a9fe117a3060d49cd222, bc3105e97a195d35b86f2425e3ea146f). Cart's own server span POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart is the failing operation: status ERROR, 44,127,284 us, same redis/ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected message. Against a comparable baseline (13:35:27Z–13:40:27Z), cart EmptyCart average span duration rose from 3.923 ms to 90,368 ms, checkout's EmptyCart client span from 4.341 ms to 90,569 ms, and checkout PlaceOrder from 47.249 ms to 90,629 ms; the rise starts in the 5-minute bucket ending 14:25:27Z (48,361 ms) and persists (41,075 ms, then 90,368 ms) with error increase 0 before 14:20Z and 5 / 2.5 / 2.5 spans after. Payment, product-catalog, cart's non-EmptyCart redis reads, currency, shipping and email were checked and show no errors and no latency regression at their own evidence. Redis's own process metrics show no restart, no rejected connections and no blocked clients, so a redis-process outage is not established; the deepest confirmed failure is cart's inability to connect to its redis/valkey store on EmptyCart, and a flagd-driven fault-injection path remains an unresolved alternative. User-visible 504s from load-generator appear on the same traced requests after ~15.0 s while checkout kept working for 44 s.
